description.value:
Trigger Zo!'s sabotage begins

Effect all creatures adjacent to a souffle take @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save. On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF].

The souffle expands to fill a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] centered on the cooking station. Each additional round, the souffle grows to fill all adjacent squares that are touching it. Creatures in these squares are affected by Sudden Rise.

details.description: A misshapen blob of pastry and magic wobbles as it keeps rising beyond normal baked good dimensions.
details.disable: @Check[cooking-lore|dc:18] (trained), @Check[survival|dc:18] (trained), or @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to gently deflate the soufflé, or @Check[athletics|dc:23] to beat the soufflé into submission
